_comment: Human-approved model configurations. Changes land only via PR. The daily refresh verifies these against the live catalog; it never promotes anything on its own. 'reasoning off' is a hard game requirement (harness sends {enabled:false}; Google gets {effort:'minimal'}) — models whose catalog entry says reasoning.mandatory=true without a supported minimal effort are ineligible.

economy.reason: Cheapest current-generation OpenAI chat tier ($0.10/$0.50 per MTok) that can disable reasoning (supports effort 'none'). gpt-5-nano is cheaper but reasoning-mandatory.
economy.notes: GPT-6 API models do not support the temperature parameter; OpenRouter drops it silently. Do not send require_parameters=true with temperature for this config.

flagship.reason: Strongest OpenAI model that honors reasoning-off (gpt-6-astra and gpt-5.x pro tiers are reasoning-mandatory or reasoning-priced).

economy.reason: Reference CHEAP_ROSTER incumbent, battle-tested in the game.

flagship.reason: Strongest Anthropic model that honors reasoning-off. claude-opus-5.5, claude-sonnet-5.5 and claude-fable-5.x are reasoning-mandatory and ineligible under the game contract.

economy.reason: Reference CHEAP_ROSTER incumbent. Google models only accept effort 'minimal' as the off-position — the harness already special-cases this.

flagship.request_parameters_note: reasoning is mandatory on this model; 'minimal' is the approved floor and matches the harness's Google carve-out.
flagship.reason: Newest Gemini that still supports effort 'minimal' (3.7-flash and 3.8-flash floor at 'low', which burns reasoning tokens against the 110-token game budget). No stable non-preview Gemini Pro exists on OpenRouter; gemini-2.5-pro expires 2026-10-20.

economy.reason: Cheapest xAI model ($1.25/$2.50 per MTok, tied with grok-4.20 but newer) that supports reasoning 'none'.

flagship.reason: Same model on both tracks: every newer Grok (4.5, 4.6, 4.7) is reasoning-mandatory and ineligible under the game contract.

economy.reason: Reference CHEAP_ROSTER incumbent, battle-tested in the game.

flagship.reason: Largest Meta model on OpenRouter (Meta has published nothing newer there as of 2026-09).

economy.reason: Cheapest blended game cost of any DeepSeek ($0.018/$0.32 per MTok); reference FRONTIER_ROSTER incumbent.

flagship.reason: DeepSeek's top general model on OpenRouter; reasoning can be disabled.

economy.reason: Cheapest capable Qwen ($0.03/$0.13 per MTok); reference FRONTIER_ROSTER incumbent.

flagship.reason: Strongest Qwen that honors reasoning-off (qwen3.8-max-0902 and qwen3.8-max-prime are reasoning-mandatory).

economy.reason: Cheapest blended game cost of any Kimi ($0.45/$2.25 per MTok), newer than the reference's kimi-k2-0905.

flagship.reason: Moonshot's flagship; reference FRONTIER_ROSTER incumbent; reasoning can be disabled.

flagship.reason: Strongest GLM with documented game evidence that honors reasoning-off. glm-5.3 and glm-5.3-prime are reasoning-mandatory; glm-5.2 is a candidate pending evaluation.

economy.reason: Reference CHEAP_ROSTER incumbent, battle-tested in the game.

flagship.reason: Mistral's premium-priced current tier ($1.50/$7.50 per MTok, above mistral-large-2512), supports reasoning 'none'. mistral-large-2512 is the fallback candidate.
evidence: OpenRouter catalog 2026-09-29: priced above every other mistralai entry, reasoning.mandatory=false
